strings: It's not uncommon for m_c to come into the medicine den with worries and troubles swirling around {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head. r_c0 has a specific pile of herbs set aside just for when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/need/needs} them.
